text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On our way back from an outing, Kiseki and I stopped by a bookstore,
and there was Vivlos, standing by a special display
piled high with wildly popular manga...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Vivlos-chan!
Do you like this manga...?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! It's super viral right now!
I came to buy merch today~!
The anime is totally insane too~♪

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Y-You're right... The momentum is incredible...!
The art is so pretty, too~...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
It didn't really hit home with you, huh,
Kiseki-san? I knew it!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Gulp...!
Sharp as ever...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I’ve read all the published volumes.
Criticizing something without reading it goes against my code, after all.”

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Besides, even if it didn't click with me,
I'm still curious about the secret behind its popularity...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Vi-chan!
If you're so hooked on it, could you tell me what makes this series so great?!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Alright, first is the collab cafe~♡
I've been dying to try this♪
Lulu-chan's Special Sapphire Magic Stone Soda!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
A cafe out of the blue, what an unexpected turn of events...!
Wait, did you just want an excuse to come here!?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Putting that nitpick aside!
You really love the main character, Lulu, don't you?
What do you like most about her?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, first off, how stylish it is!
That magical outfit is a clever redesign of high-end luxury pieces, right?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Huh! Is that so!?
I did think you had great taste, but...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Right! It looks so realistic!
This author totally knows their fashion history!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
And also~,
the part where "he was actually the descendant of a legendary wizard!"
was so surprising and exciting!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Wasn't there a pretty obvious flag for that back in episode 1?
choice_data_list: I feel like there might have been a bit...?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, it was only for a second~.
I totally forgot about it until you brought it up.
Kiseki-san, aren't you almost too sharp?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh... Maybe reading through so many patterns dulled my ability to feel genuine surprise?
Ugh, the truth hurts...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, that was so much fun~!
I really wanted to come to a cheer screening too~!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"The audience is a mix of all ages and genders...
It really feels like a nationally beloved series."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"The script neatly sorted out the flow
that was kind of hard to follow in the manga version...!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah, could be.
The original work was totally all about visual storytelling after all.
More focused on mood, I guess?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Right, right!
Even that sudden love triangle from the original that didn't make much sense felt totally convincing...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After parting ways with Vivlos, Kiseki and I bought pamphlets and spin-off manga to continue our analysis.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: In other words, the transitions were just off, and the individual elements were actually pretty interesting?!
choice_data_list: That's it! That's a great perspective.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Right!
Plus, the same author's older works
have a totally different style from now!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I think the setting and characters were deliberately
tuned to appeal to a wide audience!
choice_data_list: That's important if you're aiming for a hit.
That's important if you're aiming for a hit, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
Why is it so popular? What makes it click?
I fully understand the secret now.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Even with that said... I'm sorry!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It really didn't hit the mark for me personally...!
So I'm a little...
No, I'm pretty frustrated about it.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: If it were me... this is how I'd draw it...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki began furiously moving her pen across the page.
Rather than merely criticizing, she learns from it, absorbs it, and strives to surpass it.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
If we do it like this! It'll be way more fun!
WOOOOOOAAAHHH—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Later on, I spotted Kiseki
and Vivlos on campus.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey~! Where's the next chapter
of the Umasta manga~?
Pleeease, I wanna read it already~♡

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh...! 
We update every Sunday, so look forward to it!
Be sure to turn notifications on, too!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehh! I'm so curious~~!
What's gonna happen with that huge crisis~?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer!
As you can see, that new item is a huge hit!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Channeling her frustration into motivation, Kiseki created a piece that was a huge hit.
Looking at her, the words that spilled from my mouth were...
choice_data_list: Your creator spirit is so cool!
Thank you for your hard work, Doctor.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...!
What happened all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I was only able to draw such a good piece
because of your support,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to us having such a rigorous
meeting at the family restaurant!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ahahahaha, "teacher" is too much!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I feel like a big-shot star.
Fufufu~n♪

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to keep aiming for hits!
I'll make everyone fall head over heels for me too!
